title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $\pi_v/\beta_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\sum_v(\pi_v/\beta_v)r_v(y)$, where $r_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. translated_title: 网络上KL正则化偏好动态所诱导的聚合规则
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类智能体，它们各自将模型与自己的偏好数据进行对齐，同时观察其他智能体，并探讨由此产生的策略实现了哪种聚合规则。每一轮中，每个智能体执行一步KL正则化更新。该步骤涉及一个参考项——智能体因偏离它而受到惩罚——以及一个用于与自身响应进行比较的挑战者，这两者中的每一个既可以是智能体自身的，也可以是其所观察智能体的平均值；且注意力不必是相互的。对参考项进行聚合使该规则成为集体规则。此时智能体 $v$ 拥有权重 $\pi_v/\beta_v$，即其在网络长期注意力中所占份额除以其温度参数。此外，如果挑战者是固定的，则智能体会集中于最大化 $\sum_v(\pi_v/\beta_v)r_v(y)$ 的响应，其中 $r_v$ 是智能体 $v$ 的奖励，且该规则是基数型（cardinal）的。如果参考项固定而挑战者被聚合，则各智能体的策略在不动点处通常各不相同，任何加权的……
tldr: 论文证明网络中多个智能体进行KL正则化偏好对齐的迭代动态会诱导出一种加权聚合规则，权重由各智能体在网络中的长期注意力份额除以其温度参数决定，并在参考项或挑战者被聚合时分别导出基数型聚合与策略分化等结果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that iterative KL-regularised preference alignment among networked agents induces a weighted aggregation rule, where each agent's weight is its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature, yielding cardinal aggregation when the challenger is fixed and divergent fixed-point policies when the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated.
